correctness.rationale: For binary weight-two cyclic words, distinct disjoint supports produce a four-element symmetric difference with at least six affected windows for n>=6. Supports sharing one endpoint leave two differing coordinate positions; their triple-window supports are disjoint iff their cyclic distance is >=3. Thus feasible codes equal edge sets whose every vertex neighborhood is 3-separated on C_n. Handshake gives |E|<=floor(n floor(n/3)/2). When n=3m, a degree-m neighborhood is one residue class mod3; three fully saturated residue classes would force a fixed-point-free involution on three labels, impossible, forcing at least m missing degree units. K_{m,m} disjoint K_m attains m(3m-1)/2. Explicit circulants +/- (3j-1) with optional antipodal edges or Hamilton cycle matching attain floor(nm/2) for other residues. Independent constructed graph checks n=6..45, direct triple-read pair distances through n=22, and independent exhaustive maximum independent sets n=6..9 (5,7,8,12). The infinite result depends on the proof, not tests.
